Treatments

The complete catalogue

Every service with a clear explanation, a transparent price and the time it deserves. Colour, toner, highlight and Gracefully Grey treatments are agreed in a personal consultation first.

HaircutsStylingColourHighlightsHair Care & RecoverySuperloopGracefully GreyHead MassageCoachingSalon Party

Treatment pages

  • Haircuts Every haircut includes a personal consultation, hair wash, haircut and quick blow-dry. Adult haircuts are €35 at every length; teen haircuts €30. A Signature Blow-Dry is available for a polished finish.
  • Curls Curly hair is cut dry, so its natural movement and individual curl pattern stay visible. A curly haircut is €49 and includes a curl consultation, dry haircut, wash, curl care and styling.
  • Colouring Permanent colour, semi-permanent colour and toner, agreed together in a personal consultation. First colour, toner or highlight bookings start with a €25 consultation, fully deducted from the agreed treatment.
  • Highlights / Lowlights Foil and cap highlights with a finishing toner included in every price and appointment. Foil highlights from €85; cap highlights from €59. The finishing toner is always included.
  • Superloop A volumising treatment that makes hair appear fuller, with a result lasting about six weeks. From €89. Especially suitable when the hair on top is no longer than 15 cm.
  • Grey Hair Gracefully Grey: embrace your natural grey, or transition from coloured hair at your own pace. A €25 consultation shapes a personal plan and quotation, deducted from your first Gracefully Grey treatment.
  • Head Massage An Indian head massage for the scalp, temples, neck and upper shoulders. €39 for 30 min or €55 for 45 min of deep, unhurried calm.
  • Salon Party A relaxed salon experience together, at your home or at Maison Coiffure. Haircuts, styling, treatments and head massages for your group. Both locations work by quote enquiry.

Hair length, in plain words

Short hair: Hair that falls above the jawline.

Medium-length hair: Hair from the jawline to just above the shoulders, including a bob that remains above the shoulders.

Long hair: Hair that touches or falls below the shoulders.

Very long hair: Hair that reaches the mid-back or below; an additional charge may apply.

Haircuts

Great hair is about the right shape, movement and attention to detail. Whether you love long layers, natural curls or a fresh new cut, every hairstyle is created to suit you, your hair and your personality. More about haircuts.

Haircuts

Every haircut includes a personal consultation, hair wash, haircut and quick blow-dry.

Haircut, medium-length hair For hair from the jawline to just above the shoulders. Includes a consultation, hair wash, haircut and quick blow-dry. €35
Haircut, long hair For hair that touches or falls below the shoulders. Includes a consultation, hair wash, haircut and quick blow-dry. €35

Curly haircuts

Curly hair is cut dry so its natural movement and individual curl pattern remain visible. The treatment includes a curl consultation, dry haircut, hair wash, curl care and styling.

Styling

A Signature Blow-Dry is a bit more than just a blow-dry: a polished finish with extra attention to shape, movement, shine and lasting style. Perfect for dinner, drinks, a date or a day when you want your hair to look extra good.

Signature Blow-Dry

A luxurious, personalised blow-dry that gives the hair shape, movement and a polished finish. Perfect for a party, presentation, photoshoot or whenever you want your hair to look its best.

Colour

Permanent colour gives lasting change and grey coverage. Semi-permanent colour adds tone and depth, and a toner makes the softest adjustment; neither makes hair lighter. Every first colour booking starts with a consultation. More about colouring.

Colour and Highlight Consultation

A consultation is required before your first colour, toner or highlight treatment at Maison Coiffure. We assess your current colour, hair history, condition and desired result, then agree on the appropriate treatment, appointment duration and estimated price.

Service Description Price Duration
Colour and Highlight Consultation €25 20-30 min

The €25 consultation fee will be fully deducted from your colour, toner or highlight treatment when you proceed with the agreed appointment.

In person is preferred for complex colours, highlights, damaged hair, colour corrections and major changes. A remote consultation is possible by video or telephone, supported by clear photographs taken in natural daylight.

Permanent colour

Permanent colour provides lasting colour change and reliable grey coverage. It may lighten untreated natural hair within technical limits; the result must first be assessed during the mandatory consultation.

Service Description Price Duration
Roots only, all hair lengths Permanent colour is applied to visible regrowth only for lasting colour and grey coverage. The starting price assumes a standard amount of regrowth and product. From €49 90 min
Short hair, roots to ends An all-over permanent colour service. A softer semi-permanent colour or toner may be recommended for the lengths and ends. From €59 105 min
Medium-length hair, roots to ends An all-over permanent colour service. A gentler colour may be used through the lengths to protect the hair. From €69 120 min
Long hair, roots to ends An all-over colour service tailored to the amount, condition and desired result of the hair. From €79 135 min

Prices and appointment times are based on the selected hair length and an average amount of hair. A surcharge of €12.50 may apply to exceptionally thick, very long or tangled hair, or when substantially more product and time are required. This will always be discussed before the treatment begins.

Semi-permanent colour

Semi-permanent colour adds visible tone, richness and depth while remaining gentler than permanent colour. It gradually fades through washing and cannot make the hair lighter.

Service Description Price Duration
Short, all-over A gentle colour is applied from roots to ends to add tone, depth and shine. From €45 75 min
Short, mid-lengths and ends Refreshes faded lengths, enriches existing colour and restores shine while leaving roots untouched. From €39 60 min
Medium, all-over A gentle colour is applied from roots to ends for a rich, glossy result. From €55 90 min
Medium, mid-lengths and ends Refreshes faded colour and adds shine without colouring the roots. From €49 75 min
Long, all-over A gentle colour is applied from roots to ends for an even, glossy finish. From €65 105 min
Long, mid-lengths and ends Revives faded lengths and ends while leaving the roots untouched. From €59 90 min

Prices and appointment times are based on the selected hair length and an average amount of hair. A surcharge of €12.50 may apply to exceptionally thick, very long or tangled hair, or when substantially more product and time are required. This will always be discussed before the treatment begins.

Toner

A toner is an especially gentle, translucent colour treatment used to make a subtle tonal adjustment, neutralise unwanted warmth or refresh shine. It is softer and less colour-intensive than semi-permanent colour and cannot make the hair lighter.

Service Description Price Duration
Short hair Subtly adjusts unwanted warm or cool tones and adds shine. From €30 60 min
Medium-length hair Refines or refreshes the existing tone with a soft, translucent result. From €40 75 min
Long hair Refreshes faded lengths, neutralises unwanted tones and adds shine. From €50 90 min

Semi-permanent colour creates a more noticeable change in colour, depth or richness. A toner makes a softer tonal adjustment. Neither treatment makes the hair lighter.

Prices and appointment times are based on the selected hair length and an average amount of hair. A surcharge of €12.50 may apply to exceptionally thick, very long or tangled hair, or when substantially more product and time are required. This will always be discussed before the treatment begins.

Cap highlights, including toner

Cap highlights create evenly distributed fine highlights by pulling selected strands through a highlighting cap. This technique is available for short hair and medium-length hair that remains above the shoulders; a finishing toner is included.

Service Description Price Duration

Medium-length hair, full Suitable for hair above the shoulders; highlights are distributed across the full head and toned. From €79 150 min

Prices and appointment times are based on the selected hair length and an average amount of hair. A surcharge of €12.50 may apply to exceptionally thick, very long or tangled hair, or when substantially more product and time are required. This will always be discussed before the treatment begins.

Hair Care and Recovery

A personalised recovery programme supports dry, brittle, stressed or damaged hair with a plan suited to its condition, adjusted over successive appointments as the hair responds. Existing split ends can only be removed by trimming.

Nourishing Hair Treatment

A personalised treatment that improves moisture, softness and manageability. It may reduce breakage and improve the appearance of damaged ends, but existing split ends can only be removed by trimming.

Service Description Price Duration
Short hair Restores moisture, softness and manageability to dry, brittle or damaged hair. €35 45 min
Medium-length hair Nourishes the hair and helps reduce dryness and breakage. €45 60 min
Long hair Restores moisture and improves softness, strength and manageability. €55 75 min

Curl Treatment

A curl-conscious nourishing treatment designed to hydrate, reduce frizz and support the hair’s natural curl pattern.

Service Description Price Duration
Short hair Hydrates short curly hair, reduces frizz and enhances natural definition. €39 45 min

WellaPlex Treatment

A professional bond-strengthening treatment for weakened, coloured, lightened or chemically treated hair. WellaPlex reinforces internal hair bonds and helps improve strength and resilience.

Service Description Price Duration
Short hair A strengthening treatment for short hair weakened by colouring, lightening or chemical services. €49 60 min
Medium-length hair Helps reduce breakage and improve the resilience of medium-length hair. €59 75 min

Recovery Programme

A personalised recovery programme for dry, brittle, stressed or damaged hair. The composition is adjusted to the condition of the hair and may include WellaPlex, a restorative mask or deep hydration treatment, scalp massage, leave-in care, a light trim and personalised home-care advice.

Service Description Price Duration
Single treatment, short hair €109 120 min
Single treatment, medium-length hair €119 120 min
Single treatment, long hair €129 120 min
Three-treatment programme, short hair €299 3 × 120 min
Three-treatment programme, medium-length hair €329 3 × 120 min
Three-treatment programme, long hair €359 3 × 120 min
Five-treatment programme, short hair €479 5 × 120 min
Five-treatment programme, medium-length hair €519 5 × 120 min
Five-treatment programme, long hair €569 5 × 120 min

A single treatment is an intensive appointment tailored to the hair’s current condition. A light trim of damaged ends is included; a full haircut is a separate €35 service.

The three-treatment programme is designed to improve condition, strength and manageability over time. Each appointment is adjusted as the hair responds and recovers.

The five-treatment programme suits hair requiring consistent, longer-term care. Each session builds on the previous one and includes ongoing assessment and adapted home-care advice.

Superloop

More volume, or help making a crown fall beautifully again. More about the Superloop.

Superloop

A volumising treatment intended to make hair appear fuller, especially suitable when the hair on top is no longer than 15 cm. The result lasts approximately six weeks. After the treatment the hair is blow-dried and styled, and it can be combined with a haircut.

Service Description Price
Superloop volumising treatment From €89

Appointment duration and eligibility are agreed personally. Contact Maison Coiffure to discuss whether a Superloop suits your hair before booking.

A personal consultation for clients who want to embrace their natural grey or gradually transition from coloured hair. We assess the regrowth, existing colour, condition and desired result before determining the treatment plan, required time and estimated price.

Service Description Price Duration
Gracefully Grey Consultation €25 30 min
Gracefully Grey Colour Treatment Can only be booked after completing a Gracefully Grey consultation. The personalised treatment may include highlights, lowlights, colour blending, colour removal or toning. Personal quotation

Optional coaching

Ordinary listening and personal attention remain part of every appointment. Coaching is different: an actual session with your question at the centre, and always explicitly booked.

Coaching at Maison Coiffure

The hairdresser’s chair offers a natural, less clinical setting in which meaningful conversation can flow more easily. Normal empathy, listening and personal attention remain part of every hair appointment and are never charged as coaching unless you have explicitly booked a coaching service.

Service Description Price Duration
First Coaching Introduction in the Hairdresser’s Chair A gentle first impression of coaching during your hair treatment. We briefly explore what is happening in your life, where you may feel stuck and what kind of support could help you move forward. This is not a full coaching session. €25 approx. 20-30 min within your appointment
Coaching in the Hairdresser’s Chair For returning coaching clients. While caring for your hair, we explore a life transition, limiting pattern, difficult decision or emotional block in a setting that feels natural and less formal than a traditional coaching room. €55 approx. 45-60 min within a suitable treatment
Private Professional Coaching Session A dedicated, uninterrupted session for people who feel stuck, are experiencing a difficult transition or want to understand recurring emotional or relational patterns. €85 60 min

Coaching is optional and always explicitly booked. If painful or traumatic experiences require deeper attention, or if hypnosis may be helpful, this is only offered during a separate, uninterrupted private session.

Coaching at Maison Coiffure is intended for personal development and psychosocial support. It does not replace medical, psychiatric or specialist mental-health treatment.
